title: Heterogeneous Python assignment expressions lose their shared outer columns
symptom: Native Write and Refactor generated subtotal = unit_price * quantity, discounted = max(0, subtotal - discount), and total = discounted + shipping. Installed Check reported valid syntax but zero groups; Align refused. The common assignment role was not detected.

rootCause.summary: The Python scalar-call profiler rejects the arithmetic call argument, and the ordinary assignment profiler rejects parentheses. Shared grouping requires contiguous accepted rows with exactly the same detailed signature.

requestedOutcome: Detect bounded consecutive plain assignments through their common outer name/equal/value columns while preserving each RHS bytewise, existing detailed groups and exact approval boundaries.
decisions: Use an opt-in fallback projection with a distinct assignment-value axis; existing rule approvals remain unchanged.
Keep existing detailed table ownership and the Python three-row minimum; refuse continuation contexts and uncertain statements.
Resolve bounded detector implementation and safety verification only. Public rule and example-license decisions remain open in issue 014 and the Python calculation proposal.
